text:
Marta Li: Hi team! First day and quick security question: I got a note about Duo MFA but my personal phone can't install the company profile. Is it okay to request a YubiKey instead? Also I saw a phishing simulation email in my inbox already  is that targeted at new hires or contractors too? Who do I contact to escalate if Duo blocks my access?

Priya Kapoor: Welcome Marta :wave: You can request a hardware token (YubiKey) as an alternative to using a personal phone. Manager approval + a short security justification are required. Phishing sims are cohort-based and include new hires; contractors in certain roles get a reduced simulation cadence. No punitive action for first-time clicks  you'll get immediate feedback + micro-training.

IT Help: Marta, file a ticket with subject "YubiKey request - Marta Li" and include your manager's name. We can provision and ship one; expect 3-5 business days. If Duo is actively blocking you, open a priority ticket and we can issue a temporary OTP code.
Marta Li: Thanks. My manager is Alex Gomez. If I request the YubiKey, does that remove Duo from my phone entirely?

Priya Kapoor: Once a YubiKey is registered as your primary second factor we can remove the phone from your account if you request it. Security will do a quick review before removing phone-based factors. Make sure to keep at least one recovery method enabled.

Alex Gomez: I'll approve. Marta, I'll sign the request when you submit the form. No objections on my side.

security-bot: Security orientation assigned: "New Hire Security Basics" -> Marta Li. Due date: 2025-10-05. Link: https://training.redwood-internal/learn/nh-security-basics

Marta Li: Submitted the ticket and attached the manager approval. One small follow-up: the phishing email looked unusually short and had a link to a login page. If I click and it's a sim, what should I expect?

Priya Kapoor: If it's a simulation and you click, you'll be redirected to an educational page explaining the phish and common indicators. You'll be asked to complete a short 5-10 minute module. No HR or disciplinary action for a single fail. If you suspect it's a real phishing attempt, forward it to phishing@redwood.com first.

IT Help: Noted we received your ticket and will start YubiKey provisioning. If Duo blocks you from critical services in the meantime, reply here and we can escalate a temporary bypass.
